right.raw_text: Male  [OR] or female ≥ 18 years of age

left.raw_text: Clinical diagnosis of Graves' disease  [AND] with hyperthyroidism associated with active, moderate  [OR] to severe GO with a Clinical Activity Score (CAS) ≥ 4 for the most severely affected eye at Screening  [AND] (on the 7-item scale) and Baseline (on the 10-item scale)
Onset of active GO within 9 months of screening

right.raw_text: Moderate- [OR] to-severe active GO (not  [AND] sight-threatening but has an appreciable impact on daily life), usually associated with one or more of the following: lid retraction ≥ 2 mm, moderate  [OR] or severe soft tissue involvement, [OR]  proptosis  [OR] ≥ 3 mm above normal for race and gender, and/or inconstant  [OR] or constant diplopia

left.raw_text:
Other, more specific inclusion criteria are defined in the protocol
Exclusion Criteria:
  1

right.raw_text: Use of any steroid (intravenous [IV] [OR]  or oral) with a cumulative dose equivalent to ≥ 1 g of methylprednisolone for the treatment of GO within 3 weeks prior to Screening

left.raw_text: Use of rituximab, [OR]  tocilizumab, [OR]  or any monoclonal antibody for immunomodulation within the past 9 months prior to Baseline

right.raw_text: Absolute neutrophil count <1500 cells/mm3 at Screening

left.raw_text: Participants with decreased best corrected visual acuity due to optic neuropathy as defined by a decrease in vision of 2 lines on the Snellen chart, new visual field defect, [OR]  or color defect secondary to optic nerve involvement within the last 6 months at Screening
Previous orbital irradiation  [OR] or surgery for GO
